Select canonical_smiles, substrate_compound_name, parent_compound_name, met_conversion, pathway_key, organism, enzyme_name. Source metabolism, compound_structures, compound_records. Join metabolism to compound_structures via substrate_record_id = record_id. Join metabolism to compound_records via drug_record_id = record_id. Filter enzyme_name equals CYP2B6. Sort by canonical_smiles, substrate_compound_name, parent_compound_name, met_conversion, pathway_key, organism, enzyme_name ascending. Limit 200.
